ceu: ✦ The sextile between Venus and Jupiter

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Venus retrograde in your relationships sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: If you have an agreement to make, put everything in writing.

t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mercury retrograde in your relationships sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Go to bed half an hour earlier than usual.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Venus retrograde in your romance sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Spend half an hour on a hobby just for the pleasure of it.

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, family and money: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mercury retrograde in your romance sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Venus retrograde in your communication sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mercury retrograde in your communication sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Venus retrograde in your self-image sector, it is better to adjust what already exists than to start something new.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mercury retrograde in your self-image sector, double-check dates, messages and contracts before moving forward.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Venus retrograde in your friendship sector, people and feelings from the past may become important again.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mercury retrograde in your friendship sector, an old matter may come back, and it is worth closing it properly.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Venus retrograde in your horizons sector, review what you value before making choices in love or money.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.
Until {H:1793889499000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Venus and Jupiter brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Venus brings affection and harmony, Jupiter brings confidence and opportunities. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mercury retrograde in your horizons sector, it is a time to review and correct, not to sign in a hurry.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.
